title: Optimal T-Count for Block Encodings of Fermionic and Spin Hamiltonians
summary: We determine the non-Clifford $T$-gate cost of constructing block encodings of structured fermionic and spin Hamiltonians in a unitary Clifford$+T$ model, when arbitrarily many clean ancillas and unrestricted block-encoding subnormalization are allowed, but without mid-circuit measurements or classical feed-forward. Our main technical tool is an ancilla-compression theorem: any block encoding of an $n$-qubit operator with $a$ clean ancillas and at most $s$ $T$ gates can be compressed to use at most $\min\{a,n+2s\}$ ancillas, without increasing the absolute error or $T$-count.
